name: Shared software for every PS4 target

flavors.aeolia-belize-6.15: the only GE kernel flavor that exists

implemented_by: Orbis 0.2.0 loader + GE loader patch (memory contract, time handoff)
boot.needs: boot log (orbis-debug collect --hardware) from the console

implemented_by: aeolia/belize apcie, ahci, xhci, sky2, sdhci drivers in the base tree
southbridge-io.needs: lspci -nnk + dmesg showing every southbridge function bound

icc-power-fan.needs: orbis-hw status: fan threshold readable and writable, power button event

rtc.needs: orbis-time status shows source rtc-hardware or loader

display-hdmi.needs: picture on HDMI at boot and after modeset

implemented_by: ge-0008 engine activity + runtime GTT budget

ge-unified-memory.needs: orbis-mem bench PASS, set-budget enforced, admission ADMITTED on a game

implemented_by: mwifiex (Marvell) or mt7668 depending on board

video-decode.reason: UVD on Liverpool is a research kernel only (--research-uvd, never packed)

unified_memory.pool: 8 GiB GDDR5 shared by CPU and GPU
unified_memory.contract: loader carve-out (vram.txt) + runtime GTT budget + dmem limits

notes: Shared across targets: Mesa 26.2.5 (+lib32), orbis-native (Rust), orbis-graphics-engine (Python), orbis-gaming. They do not depend on the southbridge.
Hardware-dependent: kernel flavor (southbridge drivers), HDMI bridge path, Wi-Fi/BT firmware, loader payload, the 0.2.0 base image profile.
